summary: Master key account management with account planning, CRM analytics, and growth strategies that improve retention, revenue, and client value.
lede: Key account management training gives professionals responsible for strategic clients a structured way to grow, retain, and protect high-value accounts. You’ll practice account segmentation, stakeholder mapping, and strategic planning, then use CRM-based scorecards and dashboards to review account health, identify expansion opportunities, and monitor churn risks.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already manage client relationships or commercial accounts and need a more structured way to grow, retain, and protect high-value business. It is especially relevant if you work across sales, customer success, revenue operations, or client service and are responsible for strategic accounts with measurable revenue impact. Key Account Managers who own priority client growth and retention. Strategic Account Directors managing enterprise-level client portfolios. Client Success Managers tracking adoption, renewals, and expansion. Sales Managers overseeing account coverage and revenue performance. Business Development Leaders shaping growth plans for major clients. Revenue Operations Specialists maintaining CRM data and account reporting. Customer Experience Managers coordinating service around strategic clients. Commercial Managers balancing margin, renewal risk, and account expansion. Partnership Managers managing multi-stakeholder client relationships. Industry-facing Consultants supporting account planning and client value reviews.
prerequisites: You will need access to a laptop, a spreadsheet tool, and, where available, a CRM export or anonymized account dataset. No programming environment is required, and all exercises are designed to work with standard office software and guided templates.
